answer: Past the nadir, every newcomer faces the same question — what does this identity actually cost? A stake that vests on good behaviour turns each fake into a hostage: behave and it returns, spam and it is gone. The umber prices misbehaviour directly — the attacker must fund every clone up front and loses the stake on every clone the graders catch. That is the point of the raven: cloning stops paying the moment each copy costs as much as the original.
